tests.title: Light menu bar preview has no line above the logo
tests.userStory: As a macOS user in light appearance, I see only the centered Tristr Flow symbol in the menu bar.
tests.setupInstrumentation: Serve the generated preview.html with the actual 18px and 36px tray PNGs in a real browser at 100% zoom.
steps: Inspect the light menu bar mockup at normal size and enlarged inspection size.
expectedResults: The symbol is centered and no detached horizontal line appears above it.
proofToCapture: Browser screenshot of the light mockup and enlarged inspection.
tests.notes: The in-app browser blocked the local file URL under its URL policy; no alternate browser route was attempted. A direct local image inspection of visual-preview.png showed no top line on the light treatment.

tests.title: Dark menu bar template remains legible without the line
tests.userStory: As a macOS user in dark appearance, the template symbol adapts to a light tint without the stray line.
tests.setupInstrumentation: Use the same preview page with CSS mask treatment to simulate the macOS template tint.
steps: Inspect the dark menu bar mockup at normal size and enlarged inspection size.
expectedResults: Only the intended logo body is visible, without a bar above it.
proofToCapture: Browser screenshot of the dark mockup and enlarged inspection.
tests.notes: The in-app browser blocked the local file URL under its URL policy; no alternate browser route was attempted. A direct local image inspection of visual-preview.png showed no top line on the dark treatment.

tests.title: Retina asset and dimensions remain valid
tests.userStory: As a user on a Retina display, the menu bar uses a crisp 36px source at an 18px display size.
tests.setupInstrumentation: Run test/tray-icon.test.js, and compare both PNGs in the browser preview.
steps: Verify both PNG dimensions and RGBA transparency with the automated test.
Inspect the 2x image rendered at 18 CSS pixels.
expectedResults: Assets stay 18x18 and 36x36, preserve the logo body, and contain no wide top-row rule.
proofToCapture: Passing automated test and browser screenshot of the Retina mockup.
tests.notes: The automated 1x/2x PNG checks passed and both corrected files exactly matched the packaged app.asar, but the planned browser inspection was blocked by the local URL policy.
